patthana15.19:1.1: hetuṃ atītārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na atītārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.19:2.1: hetuṃ anāgatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na anāgatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.19:3.1: hetuṃ paccuppannārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. hetuduka ajjhattārammaṇattike nahetuduka naajjhattārammaṇattikaṃ
